title: Lossless Conversions
goal: Implement From to enable automatic Into conversion.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Standard Traits

hints: The from method must return the target struct type.
Implementing From automatically provides the into method on the source type.
explanation: Implementing `From<u32>` requires `from` to return `Self` (which is `Seconds`). Once `From` is implemented, Rust automatically implements `Into<Seconds>` for `u32`, allowing `60_u32.into()`. Returning `u32` causes compiler error `E0308` because the return type does not match. Calling `60_u32.from()` causes `E0599` because `from` is an associated function on `From`, not a method on `u32`.
